subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Upright
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Upright"** means adhering to moral principles; having high ethical standards. (ईमानदार, नैतिक)

 
 
• **Example: **He is known as an **upright** man who always tells the truth.
 
 
 
• **"Immoral"** refers to actions or behaviors that do not conform to accepted standards of morality; unethical or wicked. (अनैतिक)
 
 
• **Example: **Engaging in fraudulent activities is considered highly **immoral.**
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'upright'** is **'immoral'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stout **(मोटा): Having a thick or heavy build; sturdy.

 
 
• **Example:** The** stout **man lifted the heavy box effortlessly.
 
 
 
• **Brave **(साहसी): Showing courage; not afraid to face danger.
 
 
• **Example: **The **brave **firefighter rescued the child from the burning building.
 
 
 
• **Ethical** (नैतिक): Relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge dealing with these.
 
 
• **Example:** The company follows** ethical** practices in its business dealings.
